pages: D-NP-PC-3022 Date: To: From: Subject: November 24th, 2025 Daikin Internal, Sales, Distribution, and Applied Sales Representatives Vish Ganesan, Director – Residential Controls and Solutions New Daikin ONE Wireless RHT Sensor for Daikin ONE+ Smart Thermostat We are pleased to announce the launch of the Daikin ONE Wireless Relative Humidity and Temperature (RHT) Sensor (DSEN-TH-BWS-A) for connectivity to Daikin ONE+ smart thermostat. The RHT Sensor is a compact wireless sensor designed to measure the average temperature and humidity between the sensor and the thermostat. While the Daikin ONE Wireless RHT Sensor is not a thermostat, it delivers thermostat-like functionality by sensing temperature and humidity conditions with full control through the SkyportHome app. Homeowners can adjust comfort settings just as they would with a traditional thermostat—without needing a physical display. The Daikin ONE Wireless RHT Sensor can bring intelligent comfort control to any home with a Daikin ONE+ smart thermostat, without the complexity or cost for additional zoning and thermostats, providing a smart, economical alternative for accurate temperature and humidity detected by a single thermostat. Installation is quick and flexible. Up to 8 Daikin ONE Wireless RHT Sensors can be connected to a single Daikin ONE+ smart thermostat. Each sensor is battery-powered, requiring no wires, and can be easily mounted in any room, within the same controlled zone, to enhance comfort and efficiency compared to having only the Daikin ONE+ smart thermostat by itself. Key Benefits • Cost-Effective, Thermostat-Like Control: Provides sensing only, but enables full control via the SkyportHome app—offering a smart, low-cost alternative to installing additional zones and thermostats without a physical display • Wireless and Battery-Powered: Easy to mount anywhere—no wiring needed • Zonal Comfort and Efficiency: Measures and averages temperature and humidity across rooms • Compatible with Daikin ONE+ smart thermostat • Sub-GHz Communication: No Wi-Fi required • Battery Life: Up to 1 year • Pairing wizard for signal strength, sensor naming, and calibration • Multi-Sensor Support: Up to 8 sensors per thermostat • App Integration: Control and monitoring via SkyportHome (homeowners) and SkyportCare (dealers) apps (Continued on next page) Note: This Sales Bulletin constitutes “Confidential Information” as defined in, and is subject to the terms of, your Distributor Sales Agreement.
